Later source refactors moved the active resource definition into source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml.
additional_context: PackagedProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-39043 was a later Published/Persuasive issue that intentionally changed PackagedProductDefinition.characteristic from a bare CodeableConcept to a contentReference to the package property backbone, following the same type/value-pair pattern accepted for MedicinalProductDefinition in FHIR-31528.
